webhooks.detail: Webhook POST deliveries on terminal generation status (completed, failed, nsfw); retried up to 2h. Per-request webhook config, not general event subscriptions.

evidence.quote: Higgsfield sends one or more HTTP `POST` deliveries after the request reaches `completed`, `failed`, or `nsfw`.

sandbox.detail: No free tier, sandbox or test mode found in FAQ; API is pay-as-you-go with top-up balance via console.higgsfield.ai. Failed requests not charged.

evidence.quote: The API runs on pay-as-you-go by default: you top up a balance and pay per generation.

rate_limits.summary: Concurrency-based limit per account/model; queue limit is a multiple of concurrency; no default numbers published, see dashboard

evidence.quote: The primary generation limit is concurrency: the number of requests that may be processing at the same time.
